d: Gallery in the Palazzo di Capellio. Gradually the Partisans of Capellio are gathered.
Hair, Tebaldo, Lorenzo, and sayings.
Romeo with follow-up of Scudieri and sayings.
Cabinet in Juliet's apartments. Juliet alone.
Lorenzo, Juliet, then Romeo.
Romeo and Juliet.

Internal atrium of the Palazzo di Capellio. Opposite stairway that puts to practicable galleries. Large veronas on the galleries that put in the halls of the palace, illuminated for magnificent party. It is night. Coming from various sides the Knights and Dames invited to the party.
Romeo in Guelph dress, and Lorenzo.
The place remains clear; little by little the tumult goes away. Juliet alone descends from the tunnel.
Romeo and Juliet.
Tebaldo and Capellio with Armigeri on one side, on the other Lorenzo.
Gallery in the Palazzo di Capellio. It follows the night: the place is illuminated by ancient doubles. The music expresses a distant noise that gradually ceases. Juliet alone.
Lorenzo is said.
Hair with Séguito and sayings.
Hair, and follow.
Remote location at the Palazzo di Capellio. At the end, through a large arch, there is a gallery that puts inside the same palace. Romeo alone.
Tybalt, and Romeo.
Little by little a funeral courtship appears; slow slow line along the tunnel.
Recinct where the tombs of the Capelletti rise. Near the spectators start that of Juliet. The place is closed: with repeated shots a door opens, and Romeo comes out with Seguito of Montague.
Romeo alone.
Juliet, waking up, and Romeo.
The Followers of Romeo, chased by Capellio, and his Armigeri, who appear from various parts, are among them. The whole place is lighted by faces. Lorenzo is shocked and hasty.
